name: UGC 6757 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 6757, a nearby dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc06757-hubble
story: UGC 6757 is a small dwarf galaxy that still holds hydrogen gas; Hubble photographed it to measure its distance from its brightest red giant stars and help map the nearby universe in three dimensions.

claims.text: UGC 6757 is a nearby dwarf galaxy
Hydrogen gas was detected in UGC 6757
Hubble program 13442 observed UGC 6757 to measure distances to nearby galaxies from the tip of the red giant branch
Program 13442 uses the distances to build three-dimensional maps of galaxies
